newsitem.title: USA: Steris in $200 mln purchase with Premier.
newsitem.headline: Steris in $200 mln purchase with Premier.

text.p: Steris Corp said Wednesday it has signed a $200 million products and services agreement with Premier Inc, a Westchester, Ill.,-based company that provides a group purchasing program for an alliance of hospitals and healthcare systems.

Under the two year contract, Steris will supply Premier with products that include sterile processing systems, waste management systems, washing and decontamination equipment, surgical lights, tables and supplies.
Premier currently serves about 1,800 healthcare facilities.

Steris, which provides products and services to hospitals, scientific, research and indsutrial customers throughout the world, has market centers and manufacturing operations in the U.S., Canada, Germany and Finland.
